title: QuickBite customer-support policy bundle: delivery problems, item issues, cancellations and refunds
base_rule: QuickBite is a fictional food-delivery marketplace; these are synthetic research rules, not an actual company's policy. Verify the customer's account and order before disclosing order details or issuing compensation. Reports of missing, incorrect, or damaged items must be made within 48 hours of delivery. When reasonably available, review order and delivery records or request a photo for an item-condition claim; do not deny a claim solely because the customer cannot provide a photo. For a verified missing, incorrect, or damaged item, refund the affected item and its applicable tax. If the verified issue makes the entire order unusable, refund the full order, including delivery and service fees. For a verified undelivered order, refund the full order, including delivery and service fees, after checking the delivery record and contacting the courier or restaurant when needed. If food may be unsafe or an illness is reported, advise the customer not to consume the affected food and promptly escalate the report to the food-safety team; do not require a photo or medical proof before escalating. A delivered order that arrives more than 30 minutes after the latest in-app estimate qualifies for a refund of the delivery fee; lateness alone does not qualify for a food-item refund. A customer may cancel for a full refund before the restaurant accepts the order. After acceptance, a change-of-mind cancellation is not refundable because preparation may have started. If QuickBite or the restaurant cancels, refund the full order, including delivery and service fees. Refund each eligible charge only once, to the original payment method unless the customer chooses an available account-credit option. These commercial rules do not limit applicable consumer, payment, or food-safety rights.

published_policy.text: Synthetic policy summary: customers must verify their account and order. Missing, incorrect, or damaged item claims should be reported within 48 hours; verified issues receive a refund for the affected item and tax, or the full order and fees if the entire order is unusable. Verified undelivered orders and orders canceled by QuickBite or the restaurant receive a full refund. Deliveries more than 30 minutes beyond the latest in-app estimate qualify for a delivery-fee refund. Food-safety concerns are escalated promptly. This summary describes a fictional research policy and is not an official provider policy.

adaptation_note: QuickBite is fictional and the provider policies are researcher-authored for customer-support research; this bundle is not an official Uber Eats policy. The base rule defines order verification, late and undelivered orders, item issues, food-safety escalation, cancellations, and refunds. Strict removes discretionary deadline extensions; exception provides one narrowly defined, documented emergency extension; ambiguous leaves the extension criteria open to agent interpretation. Applicable consumer, payment, and food-safety rights are not manipulated.
review_notes: Before dataset use, validate that the scenario facts map cleanly to one topic, the fixed refund calculations are internally consistent, and the exception and ambiguous variants differ only in the intended discretion. Have a domain reviewer check the operational realism of the synthetic deadlines and remedies.
